rules.name: CVE-2026-72530 — Server Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-72530: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.. Product: Server
rules.aql_query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE (PAYLOAD LIKE '%CVE-2026-72530%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%SERVER%') AND SEVERITY >= 5 LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: CVE-2026-85706 — Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-85706: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.. Product: Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
rules.aql_query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE (PAYLOAD LIKE '%powershell%-%enc%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%cmd.exe%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%bash%eval%') AND (PAYLOAD LIKE '%base64%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%-enc%' OR PAYLOAD LIKE '%eval%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: CVE-2026-86218 — N-central Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-86218: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.. Product: N-central
rules.aql_query: SELECT USERNAME, SOURCE_IP, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM events WHERE EVENT_TYPE = 'Authentication' AND OUTCOME = 'FAILURE' GROUP BY USERNAME, SOURCE_IP HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 LAST 15 MINUTES
